# Ackermann Robotics

> Ackermann Robotics (Stuttgart-Botnang, Germany; technicians in the Stuttgart/Reutlingen region) installs and operates AI-driven robot arms ("cognitive robotics", "physical AI") for production tasks that conventional industrial robots could not automate: box erecting, packing, kitting and pick-and-place with varying parts. Robots learn tasks by demonstration. Customers pay no investment; a monthly fee of at most 70% of the cost of the position starts only once the robot runs reliably. Market: manufacturers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland (DACH).

## Key facts
- Offer: Robotics as a Service. Ackermann Robotics installs, trains, operates and maintains the robot at the customer's line.
- Price: no investment. Fixed monthly fee, always below 70% of what the position costs today (e.g. at most EUR 2,100 per month for a position costing EUR 3,000). The fee starts only once the robot runs reliably.
- Tasks: box erecting, packing, kitting, pick and place, co-packing, tending machines with light parts.
- Typical parts: up to about 1 to 2 kg per part; work area about 1 square metre per station; one or two arms; two-finger gripper; cameras.
- Setup: the customer's team demonstrates the task; no programming. New variants are learned by demonstration, retraining included.
- Support: remote operator during the customer's production hours; maintenance and repairs included.
- Not suitable for: heavy parts, cycle times of a few seconds with identical parts, joining with high forces or very tight tolerances, palletising over several layers and larger distances.
- Region: Germany, Austria, Switzerland; fastest on site in the Stuttgart and Neckar-Alb region.
